text:
Eve H.: opened a docs PR to update model-card entries for the new q4/q8 builds and add a short migration + bench notes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5087 :wave:
Tom W.: nice. can you include explicit machine/precision for the perf table? e.g., a100-40gb, fp16 and q8 runs. customers keep asking for exact repro.
Eve H.: yes, adding a column for "instance / precision" and using median p95 from the raw bench CSV. linking CSV in the PR.
Nikhil P.: FYI the SDK codeblock in the draft still uses `client.generate()` which is deprecated. I'll push a micro-commit to switch to `client.text.generate()` and add SNIPPET markers.
Eve H.: perfect. also planning a one-paragraph migration note: encourage pinning with `@q8-YYYY-MM-DD` and call out that some features (streaming, function-calls) may be limited on quantized variants.
Tom W.: wording idea: "Quantized builds optimize for throughput; some runtime features may be restricted or behave differently. Pin model variant to lock behavior"
Nikhil P.: added small Node+Python snippets and included the marker tags ci wants: `SNIPPET_START:sdk-python-q-migrate` etc.
docs-bot: linkcheck found a 404 for /sdk/examples/migrate -> broken relative path (branch: eve/quantized-catalog).
Eve H.: I moved the migration page to /docs/migration/sdk so the link changed. updating the reference now.
infra-bot: docs build failed - missing snippet block `SNIPPET_START:cli-q-example` in model-card/aether-7b.md.
Eve H.: adding the CLI snippet right now; two lines showing old/new commands.

```
# old (cli v1)
ri api text --model aether-7b-q8 --prompt "Hi"

# new (cli v2 pin variant)
ri text generate --model aether-7b@q8-2026-02-01 --input "Hi"
```

Tom W.: for the bench table use recommended batch <=16 and note that batch size 32 shows unstable tail latencies. add that under "Notes".
Nikhil P.: my bench run shows 10-12% perf uplift at batch 16 vs 8 on q8 for token/s. included CSV: s3://bench-uploads/5087/aether7b_q8_runs.csv
Eve H.: added a compatibility row: "Quantized variants" -> "Streaming: limited; Function-calls: partial; Long-context KV: experimental". kept language conservative.
Eve H.: updated PR description and requested docs review from Tom.
docs-bot: preview deployed: https://deploy-preview--docs.redwood.ai/model-catalog/aether-7b (branch: eve/quantized-catalog)
Tom W.: preview looks good. minor grammar nit in the migration heading pushed.
infra-bot: build passed (job #2412).
Eve H.: merging after Tom's thumbs-up. thanks everyone for quick help.
Tom W.: merged. closing thread. :tada:
